imported_conventions.T56: L_n=10^(n//2); long lags n<=r<L_n; starts 0<=j<L_n-r; strict cutoff; factor-two ordered normalization
imported_conventions.T62: directed Chudnovsky interval and conservative decimal-prefix classification
imported_conventions.T71: T69 five-case cyclic adjacency and pinned short-sector baseline

algorithm.complexity: O(L_n log L_n + K_n), where K_n is the enumerated prefix-candidate count
algorithm.name: integer circular prefix sort and forward window
algorithm.noncandidate_certificate: prefix circle distance > 10^guard implies conservative lower distance >= strict cutoff

tables.normalization: each j<j+r hit has ordered multiplicity 2

per_lag_ordered_counts.interpretation: counts[i] is the ordered count at lag r=lag_offset+i

short_sector_comparison.convention_warning: W5 is the cyclic-adjacent cell superset, not the strict raw near-return count
